scope: Extend responsive delivery to collection discovery and onward reading, completing missing raster coverage without changing content or composition.
changes: Explore cards and four onward-story panels use the existing responsive component with layout-specific sizes.
Added 12 existing raster sources: 11 missing Explore images plus the Konark wheel reused by an onward panel.
Generated addresses now derive from encoded image bytes rather than the whole configuration; unrelated source-list additions cannot change existing rendition addresses.
Retained originals, dimensions, alt text, credit, book metadata and SVG script sample; only referenced responsive files enter the coastal publication.
Recorded image-delivery and caching lesson in the design system.

verification.integrity: Every reported derivative matches its byte digest and filename, stays within source size, and preserves proportions. Publication contains exactly the referenced derivative set.
verification.originals: Git diff contains no changes under projects/site/public; credit and book records unchanged.
verification.search: 67 default/candidate comparisons and 11 proposed sitemap URLs passed; normal output remains noindex.

byte_comparison.scope: Unique raster sources on Explore; encoded bytes only. SVG excluded; no network timing, browser-selected transfer or perceptual-equivalence measurement.

findings.issue: First onward-panel check found the Konark wheel lacked responsive choices because it comes from the tour-book asset set.
findings.resolution: Added that existing source to the rendition manifest and reran the full build/test and coastal checks.

limitations: Implementation and verification by the same assistant; no independent review claimed.
No new browser visual or network-performance verification. Earlier browser security-policy blocker remains unresolved; no alternate browser bypass attempted.
Byte reductions compare encoded files; visitor selection depends on viewport, pixel density, browser and caching. No page-speed or perceptual-equivalence claim.
Derivative filenames change once with the byte-based naming scheme. Published HTML uses the matching build-generated addresses; original fallbacks and photo/book identities remain.
No new photographs, crops, AI images, licences, source claims or public routes. Existing image provenance and editorial limitations remain.
Normal publication remains noindex; search activation is a separate decision.
